title: ElevenLabs integrates Chimera AI character system into ElevenCreative
summary: ElevenLabs introduced Chimera, pairing its Eleven v4 emotive speech engine with the Seedance 2.5 video generation model to produce synchronized talking characters directly from text scripts, emotion tags, and reference images.
research_notes:
Open the ElevenCreative interface and select the character generation studio.

Upload a character reference image or generate a visual subject using a text prompt.

Select an Eleven v4 voice or assign a cloned voice profile to the character.

Input dialogue in the script editor and insert bracketed emotion tags such as [whispers] or [laughs] to guide vocal delivery and facial expression.

Render the generation pass to export the lip-synced character video.

Place emotion tags immediately before the target sentence or word to ensure the speech model and video generator align the corresponding facial expression with the vocal tone.

Use high-resolution, forward-facing reference portraits with clear facial features to avoid lip-sync distortion during complex emotional deliveries.

Keep individual dialogue segments concise to maintain facial consistency and prevent drift across extended video rendering passes.
